memories.memory: I was diagnosed with mild asthma at 14, and I still carry a salbutamol inhaler for exercise or cold weather.
Since early 2025, I have been getting two or three migraines a month, and my doctor prescribed 50 mg sumatriptan tablets for the attacks.
I injured my right knee playing five-a-side football in October 2024, but an MRI showed no tear and six physiotherapy sessions were enough for me to return to running.
During my first year in public-sector work, I had several episodes of racing thoughts and shortness of breath, so I attended eight counseling sessions for panic symptoms.
Penicillin gives me a widespread itchy rash, a reaction first recorded when I was a child, so it is listed prominently in my medical records.
A routine blood test in March showed that my vitamin D was low, and I took a daily 1,000 IU supplement for three months before having it checked again.
I had a small benign mole removed from my upper back in July 2023 because it had changed shape, and the biopsy confirmed that it was harmless.
